(new, U344b) scripts/orchestrator/hcom-seat:3650: broker_stop signals `broker_pid` without checking that the shell has not already reaped it; a broker that ended during the session leaves a pid the system may reuse for an unrelated process of the user, which then gets the TERM. The Router cannot choose that process. Hardening: `kill -0` and `wait` first, or the job spec.

(new, U344b) scripts/orchestrator/hcom-seat:3727-3728: the dsh launch does not close fd 7, so the shim (and, unless srt's spawn closes it, dsh) inherits the read-write readiness-FIFO descriptor, though broker_start's doc says "the dsh child does not inherit it" (:3557-3558). Nothing reads or writes the FIFO after the listening line, so no boundary is crossed (artifact agents/parent-hunter/artifacts/fd-inherit-probe.txt). Smallest fix: `7>&-` on the subshell, as on the broker's own start (:3582), and a test that lists the shim's open descriptors.
